baseline_models.focus_anchor: Harm reaches the addressees at sea; other invoked agents disappear except God; rescue to land is followed by turning away and the judgment of ingratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: Immediate harm compresses the field of usable agency. Invocation becomes exclusive when alternative addressees cannot be found, but separation from danger removes the felt need and permits a bodily turn away that conceals the benefit just received.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching a person makes the danger immediate rather than hypothetical.
Compulsion narrows available action and drives the collapse of plural reliance.
Loss or failure to locate makes the invoked supports operationally unavailable.
Vocal address supplies the act by which reliance seeks an answering agent.
Separation from the threatening medium supplies the rescue transition.
Presenting one's side embodies withdrawal after the need has passed.
Concealing a benefit identifies the final judgment as failed gratitude.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports fear-driven prayer followed by forgetfulness.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a reversible economy of reliance: necessity exposes the sole effective addressee, while relief restores the capacity to hide that dependence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from sea to land immediately precedes the addressees' turn away.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sea is not only a location but an expansive, disorienting field; rescue is an extraction to exposed dry ground. The human response treats a change of medium as a change of dependence, so attention turns with the terrain even though the rescuer has not changed.

activation_trace.role: The sea's bewildering force explains why dependence becomes perceptually unavoidable there.
Ground beyond the reach of inundation supplies the felt threshold of safety.
Dry land provides the contrasting medium onto which perceived security is transferred.
Turning the side converts a spatial transition into a change of orientation.
Covering supplies the attentional closure that follows visible deliverance.

changed_reading.before: Sea and land are successive settings for danger and safety.
changed_reading.after: Sea and land function as rival perceptual regimes: exposed dependence at sea is covered over when stable ground returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence develops refusal into a campaign that unsettles, sounds, recruits participation, and promises through deception, while explicitly denying it coercive authority. The focus turn is therefore readable as induced reorientation for which the human remains responsible, not as an externally compelled reflex.

activation_trace.role: Bodily lowering establishes submission as the orientation against which refusal is measured.
Destabilizing lightness supplies the first motion away from a settled orientation.
Audible sound supplies the channel by which destabilizing solicitation reaches people.
Participation embeds the solicitation within ordinary assets and descendants.
A spoken promise opens expectation and gives the solicitation a future payoff.
A bright but unstable lure explains why promised supports fail under real danger.
The denied capacity to rule confines the campaign to inducement rather than compulsion.
The focus turn becomes the embodied result of a reorientation that remained resistible.

structural_cues: 17:61 marks one refusal by exception after repeated commands and acts of prostration; 17:62 directs the branchless ح ن ك threat toward Adam's descendants; 17:65 then negates authority over God's servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, a campaign of inducement, denied authority, and the focus turn; I supply the arrow that this campaign conditions the post-rescue turn without causing it coercively. A live alternative is that the turn simply repeats an unaided human disposition.

changed_reading.before: Turning after rescue is an isolated lapse of memory.
changed_reading.after: Turning after rescue is a recruited but noncoerced reorientation: deceptive systems regain traction when necessity loosens, yet responsibility remains with the human actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord is presented as the sufficient keeper who gently drives the vessel in mercy; immediately after the focus, land can collapse and the sea can recur and drown. Rescue to land is therefore one protected movement within continuous governance, not transfer into a self-securing medium.

activation_trace.role: The agent who sufficiently keeps an affair supplies the continuous protector across media.
Gentle propulsion makes ordinary sea travel already dependent on directed movement.
The vessel supplies the carried platform whose motion is not self-originating.
Tender mercy frames both routine conveyance and exceptional rescue.
Calm confidence is placed under interrogation once land is reached.
Ground sinking removes the assumption that dry land secures itself.
Return after departure makes the maritime ordeal structurally repeatable.
Drowning supplies the exact reversal of the focus rescue.
Dry land is retained as the focus threshold whose supposed autonomy is being denied.

structural_cues: The focus arrival on land is followed immediately by land-collapse and renewed-sea questions, so the local sequence dismantles a stable danger-versus-safety geography.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies keeper, propulsion, mercy, land collapse, return, and drowning; I infer that turning away mistakes a changed medium for changed dependence. The live alternative is a narrower warning that either location can host punishment without making a claim about perceived autonomy.

changed_reading.before: Rescue ends when the passengers reach inherently safe land.
changed_reading.after: Rescue names a continuously governed transition; the post-rescue error is assigning security to land and thereby obscuring the keeper who governs both land and sea.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human judged ungrateful is next described as honored, carried on both land and sea, and provisioned; then the direction of calling reverses as God calls human groups with their leaders and records, followed by blindness and deeper straying. A temporary human call in danger is thus set inside a larger call to account.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed honor intensifies the contradiction carried by the focus judgment of ingratitude.
Visible carrying generalizes rescue from one crisis to sustained conveyance.
Allotted provision enlarges the benefit that the focus human covers.
The same calling branch reverses agency: humans who called in crisis become those called.
A followed leader gives the later call a durable structure of affiliation.
An established record turns fleeting crisis speech into accountable history.
Inner blindness explains how deliverance can be experienced without durable recognition.
Deviation from a path transfers disappearance from the invoked supports to the human's own orientation.
Concealed benefit links honored carriage to the failure exposed at the later call.

structural_cues: 17:70 repeats both land and sea, 17:71 reverses the grammatical caller and called roles, and 17:72 repeats the focus root ض ل ل with an explicit path complement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies honor, carriage, provision, reversed calling, record, blindness, and straying; I infer a call-and-response arc in which crisis invocation is tested by later accountability. The alternative is simple thematic juxtaposition without deliberate reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus call is a self-contained moment of emergency devotion.
changed_reading.after: The emergency caller is also a future called subject: rescue tests whether exclusive speech becomes durable orientation before affiliation and conduct are exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence describes pressure to incline away, divine stabilization against leaning, attempted destabilization from the land, and an unchanging course. These cues make orientation a maintained condition rather than a one-time insight, while also showing that land itself can be socially destabilized.

activation_trace.role: Pressure that inclines from truth supplies a social mechanism for altered orientation.
Active strengthening shows that durable orientation may require sustaining action.
Inclining and settling toward another party gives the near-turn a relational direction.
Destabilization joins loss of inward firmness to threatened loss of place.
Forced passage outside a place prevents land from functioning as an absolute stable endpoint.
A continuing course supplies the durable pattern against which momentary turning is measured.
Denied transformation closes the sequence with a pattern that does not shift with human terrain.
The focus side-turn is the orientation failure illuminated by later pressure and stabilization.

structural_cues: The plural addressees actually turn in 17:67, whereas the prophet only nearly leans in 17:74 because stabilization intervenes; 17:76 couples destabilization with expulsion from land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual turning, later social pressure, near-leaning, stabilization, and threatened expulsion; I infer that recognition after rescue must be maintained against pressure. The live alternative is that the prophetic sequence addresses a separate issue and should not be projected back onto the travelers.

changed_reading.before: Correct recognition occurs automatically once crisis has exposed the true rescuer.
changed_reading.after: Crisis can expose dependence without stabilizing orientation; the focus failure is the unmaintained turn that relief and social pressure can reverse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material extraction branch rather than the ordinary deliverance branch. It remains anchored in the focus causative rescue verb, the engulfing medium, and the following side-turn; downstream prose should mark it as a tactile analogy, not replace the conventional lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative rescue at word 12 removes the addressees from sea to land immediately before they present their side.

activation_trace.role: Physical contact establishes the tactile register in which extraction can be imagined.
Abundant surrounding water supplies the material from which the passengers are removed.
Scraping or stripping supplies a forceful extraction image for rescue from an engulfing medium.
The subsequent side-turn completes the tactile image with a body that withdraws once extracted.

changed_reading.before: Rescue is a smooth change of location.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rescue feels like being stripped out of an enclosing danger, making the immediate bodily turn away especially abrupt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapped root for the focus calling form. The reading remains anchored at word 8 and gains contextual support from destabilizing solicitation; downstream prose must present it as a split-root activation about the felt force of dependencies, not as the lexical meaning of the surface form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural objects of calling at word 8 vanish under danger, leaving only God as effective addressee.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped branch contributes forceful pushing, recasting invoked dependencies as pressures on conduct.
Destabilizing solicitation gives contextual support to the pressure image without deciding the focus lexeme.
The disappearance of those dependencies under crisis reveals their pressure without effective support.

changed_reading.before: The plural objects are merely passive recipients of prayer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the invoked network also exerts pressure and organizes conduct in ease, yet its practical force disappears when real rescue is required.

strongest_changes: Land is not an autonomous safe endpoint; the same keeper governs ordinary voyage, rescue, land, and possible return to sea.
The human call in crisis is reversed by the later divine call to accountable humans, turning a moment of invocation into a test of durable orientation.
Post-rescue turning can be conditioned by deceptive solicitation without being coerced, because the surrounding sequence explicitly denies that solicitation ruling authority.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a hinge among agency, terrain, and orientation: crisis makes effective agency visible, relief lets terrain cover it again, and the later context tests whether that recognition survives inducement, honor, record, and pressure.
remaining_uncertainties: The social-pressure reading is structurally live but less direct than the immediate sea-and-land sequence.
The material extraction and non-dominant split-root readings should remain exploratory activations rather than lexical claims.
The call-and-response reversal may be a deliberate local mechanism or a strong juxtaposition without direct causal linkage.
